name: KHAN-MD
description: A WhatsApp bot with AI replies in private chats and basic commands

PHONE_NUMBER.description: WhatsApp number to request a pairing code for, with country code and digits only. Needed for first-time linking.

AUTO_REPLY.description: Enable AI replies in one-to-one chats only. Groups are ignored.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key used to generate chat replies. Keep this secret.

OPENAI_MODEL.description: OpenAI model used for chat replies
